# `Q-27-2` — Card Toolbar or Sidebar Could Not Be Placed

> A card toolbar or card sidebar has no card to attach to, so it was left out of the dashboard.

## What this means

In a dashboard, a card toolbar (`.card-toolbar`, or a cell with
`content: card-toolbar`) or a card sidebar (`.card-sidebar`, or
`content: card-sidebar`) belongs to a card. By default it attaches to
the card that comes next:

```markdown
::: {.card-toolbar}
Toolbar inputs
:::

::: {.card title="Results"}
Card content
:::
```

Quarto warns with this code when it cannot find that card. The toolbar
or sidebar is left out, and the rest of the dashboard renders.

## Why this happens

- It targets the next card (the default), but no card follows it.
- It targets the previous card (`target-element="previous"` on a
  toolbar, `target="previous"` on a sidebar), but no card comes before
  it.
- Two toolbars (or two sidebars) are both waiting for the next card; the
  first one is replaced by the second.
- It names an id with `header-for`, `footer-for` (toolbars) or `target`
  (sidebars), and no card has that id or contains an element with it.

## How to fix

Put the toolbar or sidebar just before the card it belongs to, or point
it at the card explicitly:

```markdown
::: {#results .card title="Results"}
Card content
:::

::: {.card-toolbar footer-for="results"}
Toolbar inputs
:::
```

The id can be the card's own id, a cell's id, or the id of something
inside the card.
